يهرا (form I)
# يَهِرَّا (yahirrā) /ja.hir.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of هَرَّ (harra)
# يُهَرَّا (yuharrā) /ju.har.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of هَرَّ (harra) and هُرَّ (hurra)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
